description: Land Acquisition - Paragahadeniya, Maharagama D/S Division, Kurunegala District and Welangahawattha, Rathththota D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, locations, and survey information. While it mentions a government minister (Gayantha Karunatilleke), this is only in the context of his statutory role in land acquisition declarations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The core content is exclusively about land matters, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
